description: Golden dataset for offline evaluation of the AI Watch scoring pipeline (score_single_offer). 8 real job offers, frozen as of 2026-08-31, scored against 2 contrasted profiles to test discrimination on seniority, location and salary fit, not just topical keyword overlap.

mateo.description: Real user profile — junior AI/full-stack engineer, 2 years experience.

senior_fullstack_no_ai.description: Synthetic mirror persona — senior full-stack engineer, no AI/LLM background. Used to verify the scorer discriminates on the actual profile rather than on offer keywords alone: expected to invert the ranking produced for 'mateo' on seniority (5-8y minimum offers), salary (60k+) and AI-specific stack.

offer.title: AI Engineer
offer.requirements_summary: Joins a 7-person AI team building an LLM-based system to help cybersecurity analysts investigate threats, moving toward autonomous investigation agents. Builds investigation agent pipelines (planning, tool calling, synthesis), designs an evaluation framework, evaluates foundation models on cost/latency/quality trade-offs, industrializes via CI/CD. Requires hands-on LLM experience (RAG, tool-calling, agents, chatbots) and Python reading ability; no minimum years of experience stated. Agent frameworks (LangGraph, PydanticAI, Haystack) and ML frameworks (Scikit-learn, PyTorch) are nice-to-have.

offer.title: Full Stack AI Engineer (Lisbon)
offer.requirements_summary: First engineer based in Lisbon for an AI-powered revenue-recovery platform for healthcare clinics (voice/WhatsApp AI agents). Fully generalist: AI agent orchestration, conversation flows, evaluation pipelines, prompt engineering, telephony/messaging APIs, product dashboards, and integrations. Wants a generalist who has shipped side projects, has hands-on LLM experience, is productive in Python and TypeScript, and wants ownership rather than tickets. 0 to 3 years of experience explicitly welcomed. Bonus for real-time voice systems, Twilio, WhatsApp Business API.

offers.note: Behind 42 intra auth; content pasted by the user directly, not scraped.

offer.title: AI Engineer
offer.location: Paris, France (3 days on-site / 2 days remote)
offer.requirements_summary: Klaire builds an AI system for French notaries (Klaire), handling large documents (data rooms of 4000+ pieces) with sourced, page-level citations, since a notarial act carries legal liability and requires verifiable answers, not plausible ones. Role owns backend/frontend end-to-end (TypeScript/NestJS/PostgreSQL backend, React/Vite frontend), evolves the multi-agent system (new MCP server tools, document search, extraction, sourced citations), and builds evaluations for agent chains against real cases. Requires 3+ years experience, strong TypeScript/Node and SQL, CI/CD awareness, comfort with French legal domain. ML/LLM culture (embeddings, evaluation methods) is a plus, not required.

offer.title: AI Engineer
offer.requirements_summary: BeTomorrow is a digital agency (web, mobile, AI, data) with in-house AI products (ALLY, Planea). Role carries AI expertise across client projects (luxury, health, entertainment, industry, mobility): designing, developing and industrializing generative and agentic AI solutions in production (RAG, autonomous agents, multi-agent orchestration), productionizing (deployment, monitoring, evaluation, cost/latency optimization), architecture choices (model selection, RAG vs fine-tuning), rigorous evaluation (reference datasets, benchmarks, regression tests). Requires minimum 5 years development experience with significant, demonstrable generative-AI experience in production, plus solid software engineering fundamentals and comfort with at least one cloud provider.

offer.title: Fullstack Software Engineer
offer.requirements_summary: TheFork (Tripadvisor Group), leading European restaurant booking platform. Role is on the Business Operations team (Billing System microservices, data flows, Content Moderation app with AI-assisted features, internal portals). Builds and ships features across a microservices architecture (Node.js/TypeScript backend, React/GraphQL frontend) following DDD/TDD/BDD, participates in product discovery, contributes to architecture decisions, collaborates with AI tooling (Claude Code) as part of daily workflow. No AI/ML domain expertise required; AI is used as a dev productivity tool, not the product itself. Mentorship from senior engineers for career growth suggests openness to less senior candidates.

offer.title: Senior Fullstack Developer - F/H
offer.requirements_summary: Epsor (employee savings fintech, B Corp) is building Tuttim, a mobile-first app reinventing the individual social report. Full ownership of features end-to-end (data models, API contracts, frontend) across a multi-entity, multi-country, multi-currency architecture. Requires at least 5 years of web development experience ideally in similar SaaS B2B structures, comfort with clean/hexagonal architecture and DDD, strong Node/TypeScript with willingness to work in other languages (Go present in stack), devops culture (cloud, IaC, observability). AI is referenced only as a modern dev-experience booster, not a core skill requirement. Based in Paris.

offer.title: Fullstack Developer Node.JS / Vue.JS or React.JS (M/F)
offer.requirements_summary: Magellan is an international management and technology consulting group (IT services / consultancy, ~6700 employees). Mid-senior fullstack role working across the full agile cycle (design, dev, testing, deployment, maintenance) on client engagements. Requires solid cloud development experience (AWS, GCP or Azure), strong modern JS/TypeScript (Node, Vue or React), advanced database knowledge across several engines, familiarity with TDD/CRAFT/SOLID, fluent French. Consulting/staffing context (multidisciplinary teams on client projects including generative AI initiatives, but role itself is not AI-specific).

offers.note: Linked as 'AI Engineer' but the actual posting title is 'AI Observability Engineer' — a deliberate near-miss for keyword-matching scorers: AI-adjacent title, SRE/platform-engineering substance.

offer.title: AI Observability Engineer
offer.requirements_summary: Nebius builds a full-stack AI cloud platform (GPU orchestration, inference, compute/storage/networking). Role owns the AI observability backbone for the Azure AI platform: LLM and agent tracing, platform/infrastructure metrics. Stands up LLM/agent monitoring with Langfuse, captures traces/latency/token usage/cost/quality/safety signals, builds Python exporters, maintains Grafana dashboards and Prometheus metrics, owns Terraform IaC and CI/CD for observability tooling, supports incident investigation. Requires 5-8 years of experience in observability, SRE, platform engineering, DevOps, or cloud engineering; ML workload familiarity is wanted but the core skill set is SRE/platform, not AI application development.
